a.xlink:title: Lists the nine Windows batch files at the repository root that build, serve, check and test the site and run the compiler and IDE tools.
Covers the site generator, the PDF book renderer, the build comparison and the generators of committed files.
Covers the checks on a built site: its links, its freshness against the sources, its diagrams and its accessibility.
Covers the tools that compile, build and run twinBASIC projects by operating the IDE on a private desktop, and that pack and unpack project files.
Covers the tests of the toolchain itself, which test.bat runs and which would still mean something with no page in the tree.
Covers the tools that compile the code samples of the documentation and that survey and probe where the compiler accepts each attribute.
Covers the tools that operate the twinBASIC IDE to test add-ins and the IDE itself, to try the help add-in by hand and to take IDE screenshots.
Covers the tools that build and verify reproducer projects for twinBASIC defects, that run VB6 code to compare it with twinBASIC, and that patch the JavaScript of the IDE to test a fix.
Builds the online, offline and PDF source trees, and writes the help archive. Extra arguments pass through to tbdocs.
Starts a live preview on port 4000 that rebuilds on each change under docs/ and reloads a connected browser.
Runs the gates that read the built site: freshness, accessibility, diagram fit and sample coverage. Run build.bat first.
Runs the tests of the toolchain one after another and stops at the first that fails.
Renders the PDF book from the built _site-pdf/book.html, after checking that the tree is not older than the sources.
Compiles the twinBASIC code samples marked check_build and reports the ones the compiler refuses. Samples marked check_run are also run.
Tests IDE add-ins by machine: builds each add-in, loads it into an IDE, operates the IDE and checks what the add-in did.
Tests the twinBASIC IDE itself by machine: opens a project, operates the IDE and checks what the IDE did.
Opens an IDE with the help add-in built and loaded, to try by hand, and restores the registry when the IDE is closed. It is not a gate.
Runs the test projects of the contributed packages and reports each case that no longer does what its expect.json records. It is not a gate.
The static site generator. Builds the online, offline and PDF trees from docs/ and runs the link and integrity checks.
Renders the PDF book from the pre-built _site-pdf/book.html with puppeteer, paged.js and pdf-lib.
Builds the site from a commit and from the working tree, and compares the online, offline and PDF trees byte for byte.
Surveys the tooling for duplicated code, repeated functions, argument reading, undeclared packages and the import graph. It is not a gate.
Converts literal en-dash and em-dash characters in markdown source under docs/ to the ASCII forms that the build turns into typographic dashes.
Regenerates the subset webfonts under docs/assets/fonts/ from pinned upstream releases, verified by SHA-256. Needs Python and a network.
Measures the advance widths of Inter in a browser and writes builder/inter-metrics.json, which the build installs into Graphviz before it lays out a diagram.
Indexes the twinBASIC packages into api.json snapshots, lists the symbols that the reference has still to document, change or remove, and writes builder/package-api.json for the symbol index.
Checks the links of a built tree on the filesystem, plus optional integrity checks. Several passes run in parallel.
Crawls the deployed site from a start URL and verifies that every link the build follows responds with a 2xx status.
Runs the standalone link checker and the link check of the build over the same bytes and compares their findings.
Refuses a built tree that is older than the sources that produced it, so a check never audits a previous build.
Renders every committed diagram with the real webfont and fails if a label sits outside the box Graphviz drew for it.
Scans a sample of pages with axe-core in headless Chromium, in both themes at two viewports, and reports accessibility violations.
Derives the page list of the accessibility scan and checks that it still covers every markup construct the site uses.
A shared module, not a command. Defines the accessibility scan: its pages, themes, viewports, axe options and source patches.
Gates any change to what the accessibility scan runs, by comparing the findings of two schemes over the full page, theme and viewport matrix.
Runs the accessibility scan over every page in both themes and both viewports. It takes about twenty minutes, so no commit gate runs it.
Compiles a .twinproj in the IDE on a private desktop and prints its diagnostics. Windows only.
Builds a probe project and captures what it writes to the Debug Console of the IDE, to show what code prints rather than whether it compiles.

Unpacks a .twinproj or .twinpack into source files and packs them back, with the same commands as the compiler's own command line. A Node edition, a Python edition and a twinBASIC edition behave the same.
Tests the code that restores the registry entries of the IDE after a harness run, on a scratch copy of the keys.
A twinBASIC program that hands out private desktops, slots and ports to the tools that start IDEs and programs, and takes them back when the processes using them end.
Builds one project twice in fresh IDEs and compares the two exes, to show what differs between builds of an unchanged project.
Verifies that the publish allowlist still refuses the file types it should. Needs neither a browser nor a built tree.
Refuses any regex in the tooling that can backtrack exponentially, by parsing every .mjs file and classifying each pattern.
Verifies that no pre-render rewrite alters the contents of a code fence, an indented code block or an inline code span.
Verifies that the gate lists in the documentation match the wrappers that run them, and that no page states a gate count in prose.
Verifies that both CI workflows run every gate that test.bat and check.bat run, with the same arguments and in the same order.
Runs Biome over the tooling and fails on any lint finding, warning or formatting difference.
Runs unit tests for the site search: what each search entry holds, built from small synthetic pages.
Runs unit tests for the markdown-it plugins in builder/render.mjs, with input that no page holds.
Runs unit tests for the formatter of the Page last modified date, which no build calls.
Runs unit tests for the PNG reading, writing and comparing that the pictures of a bug reproducer use.
Runs unit tests for what an embedded image keeps: its pixels and any ownership notice, without the metadata of an editor.
Runs unit tests for the converter that draws a screenshot of the IDE as SVG.
Runs the probes of check_examples.mjs under the test runner of Node, with no IDE. They cover how samples are packed and judged.
Runs unit tests for the temp folder and profile an IDE leaves, and that ending the IDE removes them and no other folder.
Runs unit tests for the packing of the add-in folder of the help add-in into the project file that the build publishes.
Verifies that the page-count drift guard still refuses what it exists to refuse, with probes on a scratch baseline file.
Verifies that the build still warns about a page that docs/_book.yml does not mention.
Verifies that the symbol index still places each kind of symbol and that its drift guard still refuses a URL the index has stopped publishing.
Verifies that the scanners of twinBASIC source and of the attribute reference still read the shapes each once misread.
Verifies the logic of sweep_attributes.mjs, the tool that asks the compiler where each attribute is legal.
Verifies lib/cli.mjs, through which the tools read their command lines, and the recorded command-line errors of each tool.
Verifies that the pdf-lib patches of the book write the same PDF objects as stock pdf-lib does.
Verifies that the Node, Python and (when named) twinBASIC editions of impexp behave the same: same tests, exit codes, output and files.
Checks that the patched axe source computes the same colour values as the stock source, for the color-contrast rule.
Runs unit tests for the package indexer: VB6 preprocessing, package files, the api.json model and the differ.
Verifies that every NOTE and WARNING of a contributed package's section names the test cases behind it, and that each package test project is in order.
Tests tbbroker and its Node client: leases, held processes, waiting, ports, and desktops left with windows on them. Skipped unless a built broker is named.
Runs unit tests for ide_js.mjs: the byte-exact round trip of a minified file, how a local's name carries to another build, and a fix patched in as the smallest edit.
Runs unit tests for the screenshot review tool: its session, its pages, its writes under docs, and its server with a stand-in run and a commit in a scratch repository.
Compiles the code samples marked check_build and reports each diagnostic against the page line it came from. Samples marked check_run are also run.
Generates twinBASIC probe projects from the Applicable to lines in Reference/Attributes.md, for tbbuild to compile.
Reports which enclosing construct and which kind of declaration each attribute decorates in the .twin sources of the shipped packages.
Writes each attribute at each declaration site, asks the compiler where it is legal, and compares the answers with the Applicable to lines.
Runs the test projects of the contributed packages with tbrun and judges each case against the package's expect.json: documented, fixed or changed.
Runs the add-in scenarios under test/addin/, each lane in its own process with a private copy of the twinBASIC install.
Runs the scenarios under test/ide/ that operate the IDE itself, with the same runner as addin_test.mjs.
Opens an IDE with the help add-in built and loaded, to try it by hand, and waits until the IDE is closed.
Takes the screenshots of the IDE for the documentation, so that one run regenerates them after a new BETA.
A twinBASIC console program that copies a CSS or SVG file, keeping the pixels and ownership notices of embedded images and dropping editor metadata.
Lists the properties that the IDE silently drops when it loads the theme files it ships, because a property lacks its semicolon.
Draws the SVG of each picture again from its saved bundle, with the converter as it is now. Starts no IDE and takes no picture.
Writes a page that shows, for each picture with no SVG, the PNG, the SVG drawn again from its bundle and a map of their differences, the worst first.
Serves a page in the browser for reviewing what the screenshot tools decided about each picture, deciding otherwise, starting runs and committing the result.
Builds, runs and verifies the reproducer projects for the entries of BUGS-TO-REPORT.md, one folder for each entry.
Builds and runs VB6 code, to compare what a documented sample prints in twinBASIC with what it prints in VB6.
Reads, names and patches the minified JavaScript of the twinBASIC IDE, to test a fix for an IDE defect on a patched copy of the install and write its fix shape.
